title: Battle of the Five Armies Co-op Kit

paragraphs.text: The Battle of the Five Armies Co-op Kit is a supplemental Magic: The Gathering box set designed for co-op play . Although thematically connected to the Universes Beyond The Hobbit release of August 2026, this product is slated to release in 2027.

The Battle of the Five Armies is the climactic conflict in J.R.R. Tolkien's book The Hobbit (1937), where Men , Elves , and Dwarves unite against a common foe. Fought near the Lonely Mountain Erebor, it pits the Free Peoples against Goblins ( Orcs ) and Wargs , ultimately deciding the fate of the North and bringing stability to the region.

This set features new cards. 9 of these cards first became available as extended art cards in The Hobbit Collector Boosters . Three of these nine cards explicitly mention battles , and Wizards of the Coast has likewise teased the return of battles in this product.
